note: The owner's own research batches, copied from the specification. They were run outside this software on Binance Vision data (personal non-production research, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 derived outputs). This software did not re-run them. Card links for Batches 02 and 03 are this software's mapping by strategy family; the batches themselves name no card.
qualifying_note: No configuration passed the complete development and separate validation requirements. An empty qualifying list is a valid result.

batches.market: Binance spot BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, SHIB, PEPE against USDT
batches.costs: base: 0.10% fee + 0.02% adverse slippage per side (assumptions, not measured account costs)
batches.result: All 48 base-cost configurations had negative full-year returns; 24 were positive before costs.

batches.market: the same six Binance spot pairs
batches.bars: 15 minutes; at most two entries per UTC day, four-bar cooldown, four-hour maximum hold
batches.costs: base 10 bps fee + 2 bps slippage per side; stress 10 + 10 bps; one extra bar of delay
batches.result: No model had a positive median; 0 of 36 base configurations were positive for the full year.

batches.market: Binance USD-M perpetual futures BTC, ETH, SOL (actual futures and mark-price bars plus funding events)
batches.costs: base 10 bps fee + 2 bps slippage per side; funding approximated at 15-minute resolution; liquidation model incomplete
batches.result: No model had a positive median; 0 of 6 base configurations were positive for the full year.
